cause: Unlayered Swiper width:100% overrides the layered pre-initialization slide width. Browser can select 640px then 240px logo variants.
fix: Scope unlayered initial widths and gaps to direct children of responsive slide carousels. Width=(container-(visibleSlides-1)*gap)/visibleSlides. Hand layout back to Swiper after initialization.
scope: No hardcoded logo size or total item count. Native sliders and special effects retain their own layout.
dashboard: No animation wrapper or hidden style found for the dashboard in published content. Reported 1910ms render delay did not reproduce: deployed trace about 10ms, local before 18ms/after 14ms. No speculative animation or tracking changes made; reduced carousel downloads remove resource contention.
limitations: Single traces are diagnostic, not statistically robust score predictions. Local server has uncompressed CSS unlike Vercel.
CMS contrast/heading corrections and Impact 403 remain separate.
checks: Sizing browser regression: five viewports, integer and fractional slide counts, narrow containers, effect exclusions, initial requests, before/after initialization width parity.
Existing carousel parity suite passed, including touch/mouse, autoplay, resize, reduced motion, lightbox and Shopify galleries.
Astro check reports only the same two pre-existing ui-regressions fixture type errors.
